motions.text: That the report titled Downtown Community Planning Permit Decision Report (2026) – 124 dated April 15, 2026 be received. motions.item_title: Downtown Community Planning Permit Decision Report, 2026-124
motions.name: First Amendment to the Main Motion
motions.text: That Attachment-1 of Council Memo 2026-204 dated April 15, 2026 be amended to change Row 2, Columns 2 and 3 of Table 1.2 to read: Option 1: A minimum per cent of all residential units (rental or ownership) associated with the increase in building height per Schedule D, must be provided as Affordable Dwelling Units, per Table D.1 in Appendix D: 5% of all residential units associated with the increase in heights on Schedule D up to 6 additional storeys; 10% of all residential units associated with the increase building height on Schedule D of the additional 7 to 14 storeys; 33% of all residential units associated with the increase in building height on Schedule D of the additional 15 to 18 storeys. OR Option 2: A cash-in-lieu contribution for the required Affordable Dwelling Units as identified in Option 1, per Table D.2 in Appendix D. OR Option 3: A mix of Affordable Dwelling Units and cash-in lieu contribution for the required Affordable Dwelling Units identified in Option 1.
motions.text_html:
1. That Attachment-1 of Council Memo 2026-204 dated April 15, 2026 be amended to change Row 2, Columns 2 and 3 of Table 1.2 to read:

Option 1: A minimum per cent of all residential units (rental or ownership) associated with the increase in building height per Schedule D, must be provided as Affordable Dwelling Units, per Table D.1 in Appendix D:

  1. 5% of all residential units associated with the increase in heights on Schedule D up to 6 additional storeys;
  2. 10% of all residential units associated with the increase building height on Schedule D of the additional 7 to 14 storeys;
  3. 33% of all residential units associated with the increase in building height on Schedule D of the additional 15 to 18 storeys.

OR

Option 2: A cash-in-lieu contribution for the required Affordable Dwelling Units as identified in Option 1, per Table D.2 in Appendix D.

OR

Option 3: A mix of Affordable Dwelling Units and cash-in lieu contribution for the required Affordable Dwelling Units identified in Option 1.
